main_body: A small anvil: a light grey flat-topped working face, a dark waist and a base with a lighter slab. A hot orange piece with red embers sits on top.
top_band: Light grey (#d0d8e0 / #a3acb5) at rows 5-6, only 2 rows, directly under the outline and the hot-metal props. Below it the tone fades straight down into the waist (L 126, 82, 61) with no step.
evidence: The anvil is drawn as a side profile silhouette (face, waist, foot). The scan at x=7 shows a 2-row light band at rows 5-6, then a smooth gradient (126, 82, 61, 39) with no front-edge step or eave shadow. A 2-row band is too thin to read as a horizontal surface, so the top is not visible from above. The base slab at rows 12-13 is also a flat front-view stripe.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 10 distinct colours against 38-40 in the references. The dark edge pixels are 100% neutral (#22282e), a uniform near-black sticker outline, while the references are tinted (1% and 33% neutral). The body has about 4 grey steps, mostly smooth gradient bands, with no grain or texture dots. The references carry 17-20 colours per tile and richly textured materials, so the candidate looks much thinner and flatter next to them.
